description_en: Creates an accelerated IP address for a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用CreateBasicAccelerateIp接口为基础型全球加速实例创建加速IP
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-basic-accelerate-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBasicAccelerateIp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the basic GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the acceleration region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2253380.html查询加速地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id

AccelerateIpAddress.description_en:
The accelerated IP address of the basic GA instance.

This parameter is unavailable
AccelerateIpAddress.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的加速IP。

该参数暂未启用

AccelerateIpId.description_en: The ID of the accelerated IP address
AccelerateIpId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速IP实例ID

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the basic GA instance

IpSetId.description_en: The ID of the acceleration region
IpSetId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速地域实例ID

The status of the accelerated IP address. Valid values:

init: The accelerated IP address is being initialized

加速IP的状态。
